name: Do I need permits for garage entry accessibility modifications in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need permits for garage entry accessibility modifications in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depending on the scope of the accessibility modification, permits may be required in Bay Area cities like Pacifica or San Mateo. Structural changes, such as widening a doorway, altering exterior walls, or building new ramps, typically require permits to ensure compliance with local building codes and safety standards. Minor cosmetic changes or non-structural additions usually do not. We can advise you on specific permit requirements for your project during our consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits may be required for structural changes like widening doorways or building new ramps, depending on local Bay Area city regulations. We can help clarify this.
